elements.description:
Places on record – type with an icon, whether each is confirmed, the address, coordinates and when it applies –
with a place picked for a map.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the list's name

properties.name: types
properties.type: Record<string, { label: string; tone: PlaceTone; icon?: PlaceIcon }>
properties.description: Types' names, tones and icons, merged over the defaults (residence, work, frequent, former, other)

properties.name: statuses
properties.description: Statuses' names and tones, merged over the defaults (confirmed, unverified, vacated)

properties.name: coordinates
properties.description: Shows each place's coordinates under its address

properties.name: selected
properties.description: The picked place. Changed by the user unless a tc-selected-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: locale
properties.description: The language for dates, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-selected-change
events.description: A place was picked or cleared ({ selected, place }: PlaceSelectedChange); cancelable – prevented, `selected` stays as it was

functions.name: defaultPlaceTypes
functions.signature: defaultPlaceTypes: Record<string, { label: string; tone: PlaceTone; icon: PlaceIcon }>
functions.description: The types' names, tones and icons used when the page gives none

functions.name: defaultPlaceStatuses
functions.signature: defaultPlaceStatuses: Record<string, { label: string; tone: PlaceTone }>
functions.description: The statuses' names and tones used when the page gives none

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the list's name

props.name: selected
props.description: The picked place – controlled when given (null for none)

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: The place picked on mount when `selected` isn't controlled

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: A place was picked or cleared; `place` is the picked one

changelog: **People & profiles:** - `tc-entity-timeline`: events by month, each with a category and a graded source, filtered by category. - `tc-travel-itinerary`: legs with mode, document, confidence and flags, grouped into journeys. - `tc-place-list`: places with type, status, coordinates and dates. - `tc-account-list`: masked IBAN-style accounts with a status and the page's own stats. - `tc-money-flow`: transfers between entities as bands sized by amount, with flag chips. - Entities' and transfers' flows are lit with a readout, and there's a table view. - `tc-co-occurrence`: entities ranked by the events they share with a subject. - Strength in words and bars, with counts per source. - `tc-evidence-list`: exhibits, each opening onto its chain of custody, with hash agreement. - `tc-asset-list`: grouped assets with masked identifiers and a status. - `tc-contact-channels`: emails, phone numbers, messaging and addresses. - Masked until shown, with role, last use and verification.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
